brief:
A Flydubai flight bound for Tel Aviv was diverted following a stabbing incident on board, Al Jazeera English reported. Israeli officials characterized the attack as "an act of terror," though details on the victim's condition and the circumstances of the assault remained unclear.

The airline had not immediately issued a public statement about the diversion or the incident at the time of reporting.
dek: A Flydubai flight to Tel Aviv was diverted after a stabbing, with Israeli officials calling it 'an act of terror'.
title: Flydubai flight diverted after passenger stabbing
